% glossaries-extra's abbreviations (output .gls-abr) and main glossary,
% each with its sorted file beside the document from an earlier build: an
% entry whose number is in \hyperpage, which the document no longer defines
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[abbreviations]{glossaries-extra}
\makeglossaries
\setabbreviationstyle{long-short}
\newglossaryentry{fruit}{name={fruit},description={the seed-bearing part of a plant}}
\newabbreviation{tla}{TLA}{three-letter abbreviation}
\begin{document}
A \gls{fruit} and a \gls{tla}.
\printglossaries
\end{document}
